verdict: Paid ads have been dark since August 6th — lead flow is stopped.
narrative: Meta advertising went to zero spend on August 6th and has remained off for six consecutive days, which is why leads have dropped 76% week-over-week and reached zero in the most recent three-day period. All 64 leads received in the last 28 days came through Meta, so its shutdown has fully cut off new lead flow. Separately, 49 contacts are sitting in your intake pipeline with no opportunities created and no appointments booked — those leads are unworked and at risk of going cold. We are resolving the Meta disruption now to restore delivery, and the intake pipeline is being addressed in parallel. You should see paid lead flow resume and pipeline activity begin once both issues are cleared this week.
